investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of the Online Boutique microservice application on a Kubernetes (GKE) cluster. Evidence consists of aggregated query output over Prometheus container metrics (CPU, memory, disk I/O, sockets, workload, error rate, latency p50/p90), application logs and Jaeger trace statistics. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: services: adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, emailservice, frontend, paymentservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, redis, shippingservice; services call each other over gRPC; frontend is the user entry point; redis is the cart store.
